//tenantB: Credentials for a user in a DIFFERENT organization.
Without these, cross-tenant DATA VISIBILITY tests are skipped and reported as skipped —
never silently passed. Spoofing-rejection tests still run in full using a synthetic
foreign organization id, because rejection does not require the other tenant to exist.
Populate to unlock the complete matrix.
//foreignOrganizationId: An organization the tenantA user must never be able to reach.
This is a REAL organization ('QA Test Organization QA 398503'), not a synthetic GUID.
That distinction matters: rejecting an id that does not exist can happen by accident —
a lookup miss surfacing as 403. Rejecting an organization that genuinely exists, and whose
data the caller could otherwise read, is what actually proves isolation.
